summary: Uses index channels from the first input to sample/interpolate values from lookup-table channels in the second input.
key_concepts: Uses the first input as the Index Channel and the second input as the Lookup Table.
By default, index value 0 maps to the first lookup-table sample and index value 1 maps to the last sample.
Output length and sample rate follow the Index input, while output channel count and names follow the Lookup Table input.
Interpolate chooses between interpolated values between lookup samples and nearest-sample lookup.
Cyclic Range adjusts whether index 0 and 1 meet smoothly for cyclic lookup tables.
Out-of-range index values use the lookup table extend conditions selected by Extend Left and Extend Right.

key_params.name: index1
key_params.note: Index value mapping to lookup start

key_params.name: index2
key_params.note: Index value mapping to lookup end

key_params.name: chanmatch
key_params.note: How lookup and index channels are matched

key_params.name: match
key_params.note: Match by channel number or channel name

common_gotchas: Input 0 is the index channel and input 1 is the lookup table; reversing them changes the whole meaning.
By default index 0 maps to the first lookup sample and index 1 maps to the last lookup sample.
The output length and sample rate follow the index input, while output channel names/count follow the lookup-table input.
Indexes outside the index range use the lookup table's extend conditions.
Enable cyclic range when lookup index 0 and 1 should meet smoothly for looping waveforms or beat phases.
Channel-name matching leaves unmatched index channels unchanged, which can surprise generated plans.
